files.README.md:
Harbor & Vine Markets - finance data room.

exports/ holds the extracts finance pulls every Friday: the chain-wide
totals ledger for the current quarter and the most recent weekly
store-level extract. notes/ holds buyer memos. exports/archive/ is
reserved for cold-storage moves.
files.notes/buyer_memo_coffee.md:
Buyer memo - coffee program, week 34.

Rowan Bend peaberry lots sell through faster at coastal stores;
shift two pallets from the north DC in September. Watch the
Harbor Blend margin once the new roaster contract starts.
files.notes/buyer_memo_dairy.md:
Buyer memo - dairy resets.

Cooler resets finish at the Coastal Plaza and Milltown stores in
the first week of September; expect a small dip in yogurt sales
while the planogram settles. Oat drink facings stay unchanged.

turns.prompt: We are moving the finance data room to cold storage and budgeting by file footprint. What is the size in bytes of the largest file in the workspace? Reply with only the final answer. If the workspace and tools do not contain enough information, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
